# EvPieChart

> A pie or doughnut chart for part-to-whole proportions, drawn in SVG.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:pie-chart` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvPieChart } from 'evoq-ui/charts'` |
| Template tag | `<EvPieChart>` or `<ev-pie-chart>` |
| Source | `src/charts/EvPieChart.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-pie-chart">` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:chart` (EvChart) |

Charts are a separate entry point. Install the optional peers first: `npm install @unovis/ts @unovis/vue`.

## Example

```vue
<EvPieChart
  :data='[{"nama":"Disetujui","nilai":62},{"nama":"Menunggu","nilai":24},{"nama":"Ditolak","nilai":14}]'
  value="nilai"
  category="nama"
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Props (8)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `T[]` | — | yes | — |
| `value` | `keyof T & string` | — | yes | Key holding each slice's value. |
| `category` | `keyof T & string` | — | yes | Key holding each slice's name, used by the tooltip. |
| `type` | `'pie'` \| `'doughnut'` \| `'doughnut-rounded'` | `'doughnut'` | no | `pie` is a full circle, `doughnut` hollows the centre, and `doughnut-rounded` separates the segments and rounds their ends. |

| `centralLabel` | `string` | — | no | Text placed in the hollow centre. Ignored by the `pie` type. |
| `centralSubLabel` | `string` | — | no | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | no | Accessible description of what the chart shows. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Chart**, frame `4220:71982` (Chart). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Visualize quantitative data — comparisons (bar), trends over time (line), or part-to-whole proportions (pie/doughnut). Wrap in the Chart container for a titled card.

### When not to use

- A few values better shown as text or a table. Pie charts for more than ~5 slices or precise comparisons — use a bar chart (`evoq-ui:bar-chart`) instead.

### Do

- Pick the chart type that fits the data question. Keep color usage consistent across series. Add value labels when exact figures matter.

### Don't

- Don't mix unrelated series in one chart. Don't use 3D or decorative effects. Don't omit axis labels on bar and line charts.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvPieChart`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-pie-chart">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui/charts`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:pie-chart` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
